description: Pump.fun stats for one UTC day, free: coins launched and graduated, the graduation rate, SOL and USD volume, traders; the top coins by peak market cap and by volume; the deployers whose coins did best, with their record; the instant and fastest graduations; launches and the 1 h graduation rate per UTC hour; launches dead by their second hour.
